metadata.title: Cloud Monitoring and Logging

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring cloud activity, configuration changes, and security-relevant events are observable, auditable, and retained for investigation.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud logging services, monitoring pipelines, audit logs, telemetry systems, and event streams across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing consistent observability, logging, and auditability across cloud service models.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Cloud monitoring and logging build on baseline cloud infrastructure trust assumptions.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion through disabling or avoiding cloud logging and monitoring mechanisms.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Attempts to hide activity by corrupting, deleting, or bypassing logs.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Data collection activity that is only detectable through monitoring and logging.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Indicator removal or log tampering to evade detection.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Impairing defenses by disabling or modifying monitoring and logging services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Centralized log collection and aggregation for detection and investigation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring and alerting for abnormal or security-relevant cloud activity.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support accountability and forensic analysis.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Monitoring and Logging defines the trust properties required to ensure that cloud activity, configuration changes, and security-relevant events are observable and auditable. This pattern recognizes that without reliable telemetry, misconfiguration, misuse, and compromise in cloud environments often remain undetected.

components.title: Cloud Activity Logging
components.description: Records security-relevant actions performed within cloud environments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cloud control-plane and workload activities are logged for accountability and review.

components.title: Cloud Telemetry and Alerting
components.description: Detects and signals anomalous or policy-relevant cloud behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitoring systems surface security-relevant conditions in cloud environments.

components.title: Log Retention and Integrity
components.description: Preserves cloud logs in a manner that supports investigation and audit.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cloud logs are retained immutably for a duration sufficient to support investigations.
